semiconductor_relevance: High — Sino IC Technology Co., Ltd. provides critical testing services that are essential for ensuring the quality and reliability of semiconductor products.
summary: Sino IC Technology Co., Ltd. is a prominent integrated circuit testing service provider in China, offering comprehensive testing solutions across the semiconductor value chain. Their services include test software and hardware development, wafer and finished product testing, and high-reliability inspection, supporting a wide range of semiconductor products.

regional_presence.China: Sino IC operates a national public service platform and technology innovation center, with over 35,000 square meters of facilities dedicated to testing services.
